Claimants

During an insolvency process, a claimant (creditor) may require several legal services from a law firm to ensure their claims are properly represented and maximized. These services generally fall into claim verification, representation, negotiation, litigation, and compliance.

Claimant Type Key Legal Services Needed
Financial Creditors (Banks, NBFCs) Debt enforcement, CoC representation, restructuring advisory
Operational Creditors (Vendors, Suppliers) Claim filing, litigation for dues, contract enforcement
Employees & Workmen Salary/wage claim representation, benefits recovery
Government Authorities (Tax departments, regulatory bodies) Statutory dues recovery, priority claim assertion
Investors & Shareholders Legal recourse for equity investments, fraud claims
